title: Clearer, more accessible sign-in pages
description: Organization and Super Admin sign-in use consistent pill-shaped actions, clearer heading and body sizes, larger recovery targets and controls that grow with text. The background is quieter and reduced-transparency preferences use an opaque card. GitHub-specific recovery guidance only appears for a GitHub sign-in error. Existing provider availability, safe return destinations, loading states and administrator recovery are preserved.
upgrade: Rebuild and restart the web service.
